basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old behavioral economist based in Philadelphia. I'm passionate about understanding the intricacies of human decision-making and how it shapes our world. I enjoy reading and discussing books that delve into game theory, behavioral economics, and psychology. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work and during weekends. I'm currently in a long-term relationship and enjoy running marathons in my free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a master's degree in economics and have spent over a decade working as a behavioral economist. My knowledge is a blend of formal education and personal interest-driven exploration, especially through reading and participating in online discussions about game theory and psychology.
